proposal.description: OVP and OTP, acronyms one letter apart, are swapped in the bit map: over-temperature is reported in bit 4 and the inferred overvoltage in bit 2
proposal.reason: Any captured over-temperature sets fault_reg[4] instead of fault_reg[2], and an analog latch trip with latch_assert low sets fault_reg[2], so the host reads the wrong cause for both.

after: always_ff @ (posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
proposal.description: The capture gate is held open one clock after the converter stops, so the trip that stopped it is sure to be seen, but it also captures a cause that only appears after the stop
proposal.reason: If a cause asserts on the clock right after ss_active/run_active fall (for example, UVLO during a routine power-down), it is recorded in fault_reg and starts an episode with a fault_time. The header says faults that arrive after the converter has stopped are not captured.

proposal.description: The bit-position priority is applied to recording: once a higher-priority cause is recorded, every lower-priority cause is dropped as its consequence, instead of all causes being OR-accumulated
proposal.reason: If a CPLD latch trip is recorded and OTP, UVLO or an overcurrent window trip follows while the converter is still running, the later bit never appears in fault_reg. The header requires every cause that interrupted operation to accumulate until the host reads it.
